prompt: Where should she leave it tonight?
promptZh: 她今晚應把紙捆放在哪裡？

options.text: At the curb, clear of the path
options.whyZh: 今晚要留在有屋簷的地方；路緣旁是明早才放的位置。

options.text: Under the porch roof, clear of the path
options.zh: 在門廊屋簷下，且不擋路
options.whyZh: 屋簷下可避免弄濕，也沒有堵住通往大門的路。

options.text: Under the porch roof, across the path
options.zh: 在門廊屋簷下，橫放在通道上
options.whyZh: 雖然有屋簷，但堵住通往大門的路。

options.text: At the curb, across the path
options.whyZh: 不符合今晚放屋簷下和保持通道暢通的兩項指示。

explanationZh: 屋簷下可避免弄濕，也沒有堵住通往大門的路。
evidence: Yes. Keep it under the porch roof tonight. The truck won’t take wet paper, even if it’s tied. / No. I’ll put both bundles at the curb in the morning. Keep the path to the front door clear.
